lines: The kora is a string instrument.
It is made of a gourd.
The djembe is a percussion instrument.
It is made of wood and animal skin.
The algaita is a wind instrument.
Musicians blow into a reed at the top.
ko: 연주자들은 윗부분의 리드에 바람을 불어 넣는다.
body.text: The kora is a string instrument. It is made of a gourd. Musicians play the strings. It sounds clear. The djembe is a percussion instrument. It is made of wood and animal skin. Musicians hit its top. It sounds heavy. The algaita is a wind instrument. It is made of wood. Musicians blow into a reed at the top. It sounds sharp.
